reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Anola as a cryptocurrency passive-income investment, directs viewers to a sign-up invitation, and claims professional trading robots will multiply their cryptocurrency. The narration encourages deposits with specific profit and daily-income claims, including a suggested $35 starting amount, while dashboard displays and an 8% partner payment reinforce the investment pitch. The disclaimer and due-diligence warning appear alongside the invitation and return claims rather than replacing the solicitation with critical or educational coverage.

citations.quote: 👉Sing-up: https://anola.io/en/invite/B6EA7C064E This is a unique investment project where your cryptocurrency will be multiplied by professional trading robots!

There is an option of passive investing in projects that can bring you returns at a distance. Today we want to remind you about the Annua project. In short, it is a project that allows you to invest in a portfolio of trading robots.
About a month ago we invest 15000 dollars in the Enola project.
Post-the-past period, we have received the profit on our deposit of 536 dollars.
Right now we are investing another 1500 dollars,by increasing our daily income to 20 dollars.

opening.argument: Judge, the invitation deserves scrutiny, but the video also explicitly tells viewers to research the company, product, or service for themselves and disclaims responsibility for losses. That is a meaningful qualification of the investment discussion, not a promise that viewers cannot lose money. The narration even raises the possibility of a prolonged crypto bear market. Read in that context, the reported return is a personal account of one period, not proof that the same result is guaranteed to every viewer.

citations.quote: Я призываю зрителей проводить собственные исследования с должной осмотрительностью о компании, продукте или услуге, упомянутых в пресс-релизе.
не несу ответственности за любые убытки или потери, связанные с любыми продуктами или услугами, упомянутыми в видео.
are you ready for a possible three to four years of crypto bear market
Post-the-past period, we have received the profit on our deposit of 536 dollars.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The sign-up invitation and trading-robot description establish that the project is presented favorably; they do not establish that its returns are guaranteed or that the speaker conceals investment risk. The cited $536 is described as a result from a past period, while the description expressly urges viewers to conduct their own research.

citations.quote: Post-the-past period, we have received the profit on our deposit of 536 dollars.
Я призываю зрителей проводить собственные исследования с должной осмотрительностью о компании, продукте или услуге, упомянутых в пресс-релизе.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A due-diligence disclaimer does not undo the direct invitation to sign up or the claim that trading robots will multiply viewers' cryptocurrency. The narration moves beyond recounting a past result: it says another deposit will increase daily income and urges viewers to start. A bear-market warning makes the pitch more pointed when the video presents Anola as the answer.

citations.quote: 👉Sing-up: https://anola.io/en/invite/B6EA7C064E This is a unique investment project where your cryptocurrency will be multiplied by professional trading robots!
Right now we are investing another 1500 dollars,by increasing our daily income to 20 dollars.
ANOLE is your best defense, against the bear market. Making money with Anole is not that hard. You just have to start.

opening.argument: Judge, the video can be read as a review and account demonstration. Its description calls it a summary of the creators' investment and asks what they earned in a month; the narration then introduces a financial report rather than merely asserting an abstract return. It also describes how a user can switch cryptocurrency and request a withdrawal through the personal account. Those details give viewers material to inspect and evaluate. Showing an interface and reporting an experience do not, by themselves, verify the service or require viewers to invest.

citations.quote: Today we have a summary of our investment in the Anola project.
Wondering how much we earned in a month? Watch our review to find out!
Now on the screen you can see our financial report on investment with Enola.
You can always simply enough switch from another cryptocurrency to Cardano and request to withdrawal in that cryptocurrency. This is done in your personal account.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening points to an invitation and reported profits, but those features can accompany a review. A displayed financial report illustrates what the speaker says happened; it does not establish that viewers are promised the same outcome. The description also identifies a segment about the referral program, which is relevant context for evaluating the review's incentives.

citations.quote: Now on the screen you can see our financial report on investment with Enola.
3:54 About referral program

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the video a review does not make its account display an independent test. The description supplies a sign-up invitation and says trading robots will multiply viewers' cryptocurrency. The narration interprets its reported result as excellent passive income and announces another investment to increase daily income. The demonstration serves that favorable investment pitch; it does not verify the displayed returns.

citations.quote: 👉Sing-up: https://anola.io/en/invite/B6EA7C064E This is a unique investment project where your cryptocurrency will be multiplied by professional trading robots!
As you can see, it's quite an excellent passive income.
Right now we are investing another 1500 dollars,by increasing our daily income to 20 dollars.

opening.argument: Judge, the evidence also supports reading this as promotion of a purported investment service with an affiliate program, without settling whether the service is fraudulent. The speaker describes a portfolio of trading robots, a stated partner payment, and an account option for requesting withdrawals in Cardano. Those are claims about how the offered service works, not evidence here of stolen credentials, an inability to withdraw, or an actual loss. The claims deserve skepticism, but the supplied account does not independently establish that the reported withdrawals are false.

citations.quote: In short, it is a project that allows you to invest in a portfolio of trading robots.
Anola is ready to pay its partners as much a 8 percent of the deposited capital.
You can always simply enough switch from another cryptocurrency to Cardano and request to withdrawal in that cryptocurrency.
And in addition, the project regularly and quickly withdraws money, earned on investments.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution correctly identifies a deposit-based offer and an invitation; those facts establish promotion, not whether the underlying service pays as described. Its cited profit and increased daily-income statements are the speaker's claims, not independent proof of either genuine returns or fabricated ones. The alleged mechanism remains an investment-service claim whose truth this video does not resolve.

citations.quote: Post-the-past period, we have received the profit on our deposit of 536 dollars.
Right now we are investing another 1500 dollars,by increasing our daily income to 20 dollars.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The concern does not depend on proving a completed theft. The video asks viewers to use a sign-up invitation, claims trading robots will multiply cryptocurrency, and ties another deposit to higher daily income. The partner payment is explicitly based on deposited capital. Describing withdrawals does not independently verify them or turn this return-focused solicitation into ordinary service coverage.
